dedupe_keys.name: comprehensive inner magnetosphere ionosphere cimi model

description: CIMI computes coupled ring-current and radiation-belt particle distributions. It represents drift, particle losses and diffusion within a changing magnetospheric environment and requires initial conditions and time-dependent boundary distributions. The resource is documented by NASA GSFC; NASA/GSFC. The documented physical domain is Geospace, Magnetosphere / Inner Magnetosphere / RingCurrent, Magnetosphere / Inner Magnetosphere / RadiationBelt; grid spacing, supported periods and cadence depend on this version and its chosen configuration. The documentation links Runs-on-Request. A software licence and any external distribution charge are not stated. The documented version uses empirical magnetic fields, which limits physical self-consistency. The documented space-weather effects make it a potential environmental input for infrastructure hazard exposure and resilience simulations. It is related to platform-nasa-ccmc in this catalogue. The cited documentation is available online; underlying files were not downloaded. Spatial and temporal resolution were not independently established. Only metadata were checked; numerical accuracy and current service availability remain unverified.
